fullPassage: Everyone's heard the expression don't let the perfect become the enemy of the good. If you want to get over an obstacle so that your idea can become the solution-based policy you've long dreamed of, you can't have an all-or-nothing mentality. You have to be willing to alter your idea and let others influence its outcome. You have to be okay with the outcome being a little different, even a little less, than you wanted. Say you're pushing for a clean water act. Even if what emerges isn't as well-funded as you wished, or doesn't match how you originally conceived the bill, you'll have still succeeded in ensuring that kids in troubled areas have access to clean water. That's what counts, that they will be safer because of your idea and your effort. It may not be everything you wanted, but it's a heck of a lot more than nothing, and you should be proud of helping move the needle forward.

questions.passage: Everyone's heard the expression don't let the perfect become the enemy of the good. If you want to get over an obstacle so that your idea can become the solution-based policy you've long dreamed of, you can't have an all-or-nothing mentality. You have to be willing to alter your idea and let others influence its outcome. You have to be okay with the outcome being a little different, even a little less, than you wanted. Say you're pushing for a clean water act. Even if what emerges isn't as well-funded as you wished, or doesn't match how you originally conceived the bill, you'll have still succeeded in ensuring that kids in troubled areas have access to clean water. That's what counts, that they will be safer because of your idea and your effort. It may not be everything you wanted, but it's a heck of a lot more than nothing, and you should be proud of helping __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 바늘을 앞으로 움직이는(move the needle forward) 것을 자랑스러워해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① move the needle forward: 원문 일치 — 진전을 이루다 ←정답
❌ ② have an all-or-nothing mentality: 이것은 하지 말아야 할 것
❌ ③ get over an obstacle: 앞부분 표현이지만 이 빈칸 위치와 부적합
❌ ④ let others influence its outcome: 앞부분 표현
det.tip: move the needle forward = 바늘을 앞으로 움직이다 (진전을 이루다)
